The following events took place in '''3840 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Lurker/Legends|Lurkers]] are discovered on a [[Unidentified jungle world (Torch Nebula)|jungle world]] at the edges of the [[Torch Nebula/Legends|Torch Nebula]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Lurker}}</ref><ref name="Time">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act III of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3640 BBY]]. Since the Codex entry for [[Lurker/Legends|lurkers]] can only be discovered on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], which is visited by all classes in Act III, the information contained therein can be dated to 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. The Codex entry states that lurkers became known in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of the game, which corresponds to 3840 BBY.</ref>
